info.title: Preview API
info.description:
Customers, their 3D models and the models' versions, shown view-only behind a link per customer. Every operation mirrors an MCP tool of /mcp, named in its description.

Every error is JSON, `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`. Besides the responses listed per operation, an unknown path answers 404, a method an operation doesn't have 405 with `Allow`, and a failure on the server's side 500 (`internal`) without details.

get.description: The REST counterpart of the MCP tool `list_versions`.

parts.description: How many parts its 3MF has; null until its 3MF has been read (reread_facts).

source.description: file: Bambu Studio's own slice in the 3MF; slicer: the slicing service's, on its fixed profiles.

grams.description: Weight in grams, the whole model.

figures.description: What printing the whole model takes; null while there are none (see slicing).

slicing.description: pending: the slicing service will answer for a 3MF without figures of its own; failed: it couldn't (slicing_error); null otherwise.

slicing_error.description: Why the slicing failed (the service's reason, such as off_plate or too_large).
